selection_rationale.distinct_from_commodity_only_breakout_gr: broad cross-asset within-symbol compression-conditioned release with path-dependent reentry exit
selection_rationale.information_gain: tests whether low-volatility state compression followed by causal range release creates larger gross headroom without external data

universe_rule.outcome_blind: all recovered authentic M5 symbols with >=40 distinct ISO weeks and >=30000 M5 rows
universe_rule.eligible_symbol_id_set_source: deterministically reconstruct from the two accepted DEVELOPMENT archives under the frozen rule; HIGH_QUALITY delta supersedes duplicate symbol IDs

signal.precondition_contiguity: require every M5 link used by 72-bar long volatility window, 12-bar breakout box, breakout bar, entry and exit path to be exactly 300 seconds; otherwise skip event
signal.compression_ratio: short_scale / long_scale, computed only from completed bars ending immediately before breakout bar
signal.breakout_rule: on completed breakout bar t, LONG if close_t exceeds log(box_high) by at least breakout_strength * long_scale; SHORT if close_t is below log(box_low) by at least breakout_strength * long_scale
signal.overlap_policy: within each frozen cell and symbol, after an accepted entry ignore later signals until that position exits
signal.failure_exit: if a completed post-entry close re-enters the pre-breakout box boundary (LONG close <= box_high; SHORT close >= box_low), exit at next contiguous M5 open
signal.time_exit: if no reentry failure, exit at next open after maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry bars
signal.ambiguous_or_missing: right-censor/fail-closed; no interpolation, repair, or gap bridging

multiplicity.family: all frozen symbol x parameter cells

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one-step parameter-grid adjacency within same symbol
